correctness.rationale: The proof is complete: with no label 2 only the all-one assignment works; with 2s in at least two parts every zero sees a 2 outside its part; with a unique 2-containing part, feasibility is exactly absence of zeros in that part. The generating-function terms are precisely these disjoint cases. The minimum weights/counts follow by exhausting weights 2, 3 and 4. The packaged exhaustive checker verifies every complete multipartite isomorphism type through order ten, but the universal claim rests on the symbolic partition.
